proposals.rationale: The announcement names command launch units, which the index binds to the Javelin (AAWS-M) System Summary procurement line 0648CC0007 (lexicon doc 345), and the deliverables - rounds, command launch units and battery coolant unit spares - are the Javelin program's own hardware, bought from the Javelin joint venture. The identical CLU name is also owned by the Javelin RDT&E line 0604611A; the collision resolves to the procurement line because these are production deliverables under a foreign military sales production contract, not development articles.

refute_a.reason: Money colour fails: the entire obligation is "fiscal 2018 other procurement (Army) funds in the amount of $94,886,553" - account 2035A - against 0648CC0007, which budget_lines places in 2032A Missile Procurement, Army; the award's account list does include 021-2017/2019-2032 and 021-2018/2020-2032 (PZ0095, "definitization of FY17 Javelin production"), but the paragraph claims none of it and names a six-nation FMS case instead, so by chunk_000_A records 64/79 this action did not pay for the Javelin (AAWS-M) System Summary line's own work.

refute_b.reason: The Javelin RDT&E line 0604611A (doc 355) owns the identical 'Command Launch Unit (CLU)' name, but the deliverables here are production rounds, CLUs and battery coolant spares under a foreign military sales production contract on procurement funds, which an RDT&E line cannot execute; no third PE in the index owns a Javelin name.

proposals.announcement_evidence: for contractor logistics services for the unmanned aircraft system Gray Eagle Block Zero
proposals.rationale: Rejected by section 3 as generic services attached to a platform. The Gray Eagle name is present, but what the modification buys is contractor logistics services for fielded Block Zero aircraft, paid with fiscal 2018 operations and maintenance, Army funds - operations-and-maintenance sustainment hung on an aircraft procurement line, which is precisely the failure mode the rubric names. Gray Eagle here is the platform the services support, not the program element being executed.
